commits.author: ab

commits.subject: test: ui pdf - the integer coordinate methods before any metafile
commits.body:
The regression test of #712 for #713: a TPdfCanvas descendant calls
MoveToI(100, 100), LineToI(200, 300) and Stroke on a fresh A4 page and
expects '100 742 m', '200 542 l' and no 'Nan'. It fails 3/3 before #713.
Delphi 7, Delphi 13 Win32/Win64, FPC 3.3.1 and FPC 3.2.2 Win64 pass all;
FPC 3.2.2 Win32 fails MetafileRenderingAndOrientation #3 with or without it.
commits.author: Sven Harazim

commits.subject: Merge pull request #713 from ijbranch/fix-canvas-default-mapping
commits.body: ui: pdf - fixed TPdfCanvas integer coordinate methods before any metafile rendering
commits.author: ab

commits.subject: ui: pdf - fixed TPdfCanvas integer coordinate methods before any metafile rendering
commits.body:
TPdfCanvas.Create left fWinSize/fViewSize and fWorldFactorX/Y at 0, so I2X/I2Y
(and MoveToI, LineToI, BoxI...) computed 0/0 and wrote NaN coordinates until a
metafile set them; start with the identity mapping used for MM_TEXT.
commits.author: Ian Branch
